info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-Delete Healthcare Appointments Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointment Cancellation API enables providers to efficiently cancel scheduled appointments within the healthcare management system. This endpoint supports the removal of appointments when patients can no longer attend their scheduled visits, ensuring that resources are effectively managed. Typical consumers include healthcare providers and administrative staff who need to maintain accurate appointment records. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their appointment management workflow and improve patient experience.

delete.description: This endpoint allows the user to cancel a previously scheduled appointment. Ensure that the appointment is eligible for cancellation based on the current policies.

requestBody.description: Request body for canceling an appointment. It requires specifying the appointment ID and any relevant details required to process the cancellation.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelReques.description: The request body for cancelling an appointment.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelRespon.title: Cancel Appointment Response

status.description: The status of the cancellation operation, true if successful, false otherwise.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the cancellation.

resultId.description: The ID of the result corresponding to this cancellation action.

state.description: The current state of the appointment after the cancellation request.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A descriptive message about the cancellation operation result.

audit.description: Audit information related to the cancellation operation.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelRespon.description: This schema represents the response payload for a successful cancel appointment operation.
